title: BinaryVQA: A Versatile Test Set to Evaluate the Out-of-Distribution Generalization of VQA Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model performance using a newly introduced metric called 'ShuffleAcc', which calculates accuracy over randomly selected, perfectly balanced subsets of 'yes' and 'no' questions to counteract the models' statistical tendency to guess 'yes'.

Testing pre-trained VQA models on a novel, highly diverse dataset (BinaryVQA) that intentionally lacks a paired training set, in order to measure the performance degradation caused by models overfitting to the statistics of standard training datasets (like VQA v2).
